rust.reason: A hook is a user-defined type implementing `LlmHook`, which a fixture cannot express, so a plain-client snippet would demonstrate no hook.

python.reason: Hooks are Rust trait objects: the client builder takes an `Arc<dyn LlmHook>` and `LlmHook` is `alef(skip)`, so the python binding cannot register one and a plain-client snippet would demonstrate no hook.
